facts.fact: WordStream/LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark gives a median US search ad conversion rate of 8.18%.
facts.quote: WordStream/LocaliQ’s 2026 benchmark puts the median US search ad conversion rate at 8.18%, ranging from 2.64% in finance and insurance to 16.22% in animals and pets.

facts.fact: In the WordStream/LocaliQ dataset, industry conversion rates range from 2.64% in finance and insurance to 16.22% in animals and pets.
facts.quote: ranging from 2.64% in finance and insurance to 16.22% in animals and pets.

facts.fact: The WordStream/LocaliQ 8.18% median is based on 13,474 US campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads between April 2025 and March 2026.
facts.quote: across 13,474 US campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads between April 2025 and March 2026

facts.fact: WordStream's conversion rate in the search benchmark is conversions per ad click and counts every conversion action advertisers track.
facts.quote: The rate is conversions per ad click. It counts every conversion action advertisers track, so a form fill, a call and a purchase all count the same.

facts.fact: Site-wide and ecommerce conversion benchmarks run lower than ad-click benchmarks, around 2% to 8%.
facts.quote: Site-wide and ecommerce benchmarks run lower, around 2% to 8%, because they divide by sessions or visitors instead of ad clicks.

facts.fact: WordStream's first report, in 2016, gave a conversion rate of 2.70%.
facts.quote: WordStream’s first report, in 2016, gave 2.70%.

facts.fact: WordStream's Google Ads benchmarks 2026 page was last updated September 16, 2026.
facts.quote: which was last updated September 16, 2026.

facts.fact: Ruler counts form submissions and phone calls as conversions, across all traffic sources rather than ads alone.
